feeds.title: The Rawtarian
feeds.description: My name is Laura-Jane The Rawtarian, and I first began eating raw vegan food in August 2009. It changed my life, and I created this website to share the easiest, most delicious raw vegan recipes with the world.

feeds.title: Raw Food Recipes News
feeds.description: Follow us to keep up with Raw Food Recipes.

feeds.title: Oh My Veggies
feeds.description: Welcome to Oh My Veggies, a vegetarian food blog with a focus on easy recipes made with fresh, seasonal ingredients. We're all about unfussy, delicious meals that anyone can make. When your food tastes good, you focus on what's on your plate, not what's missing from it!

feeds.title: Fragrant Vanilla Cake
feeds.description: I am a vegan girl who is passionate about good food! I especially like to create healthier desserts and veggie filled dishes. I also believe that food is art and is meant to be shared!

feeds.title: Raw Blend Blog
feeds.description: At Raw Blend you will find a huge online database of health information including Raw Food and Blending Recipes, Videos, Health Information and Inspiration, Tips, News & Events.

feeds.title: Live Remedy
feeds.description: Mizpah Matus is dedicated to inspiring people about the healing potential of a diet. based on living foods. On her website, Live Remedy, she shares practical information, advice, and delicious plant-based recipes that help people transform their lives and experience optimal wellbeing.

feeds.title: Raw Food Chef Blog
feeds.description: The blog indicates information about preparing healthy raw food and starting a raw food career. Living Light offers a variety of practical yet fun and life-transforming training who plans to forge a career in the fast-growing arena of raw living foods.

feeds.title: Rawmazing Raw and Cooked Vegan Recipes
feeds.description: Rawmazing is a great resource to learn about raw food. You will find articles and wonderful recipes that are easy and delicious!

feeds.title: Carol Alt Blog
feeds.description: Carol is an international supermodel, actress, entrepreneur, raw-food enthusiast which keeps posting about raw food and how her journey changed because of raw food.

feeds.title: Raw Manda
feeds.description: I'm Amanda, a vegan food lover thriving on an abundant life full of vibrant fruits and veggies! My philosophy on health is simple feel your best by eating fresh, natural, living, unprocessed foods. I've created this space to provide plant-based recipes, inspire healthy habits and share my vegan lifestyle.

feeds.title: Raw Revive
feeds.description: Renew yourself with Raw Vegan Recipes! All recipes here are vegan and gluten-free, some cooked but mostly raw.

feeds.title: EZ Raw Vegan Living
feeds.description: My name is Maureen and I'm a Raw Chef who has been mostly raw and vegan for 13 years. I have experienced many health benefits after transforming myself into a vegetarian.

feeds.title: This Rawsome Vegan Life
feeds.description: This Blog is meant to give nourishing and delicious recipes for all to enjoy. You'll find mainly raw and some cooked recipes, mostly desserts along with insights into veganism and raw foodism, resources for/about the lifestyle, and (hopefully) helpful information about life-giving food.

feeds.title: Raw Food Recipes
feeds.description: Looking for healthy vegetarian, vegan and raw food recipes? We showcase many of the top vegan chefs with trusted recipes, videos and more!
